_about: C1a-09, the form pass (stage C1 section 7). Each pattern: name; re, given to mem.py codes --grep (case-insensitive, over words, label and note joined, so unanchored); text, a stricter pattern applied to the quoted words alone where anchors or shape matter (else re is applied to the words); why. Run with c1_form_pass.py sweep <name>.

form.name: one-line commitment
form.re: \b(i'?m in|on it|omw|on my way|i'?ll help|working on it|count me in|will do|reporting for duty|i'?ll join|joining)\b
form.text: ^\W*(i'?m in|im in|on it|i'?m on it|omw|on my way|i'?ll help|ill help|working on it|count me in|will do|reporting for duty|i'?ll join|ill join|joining)\W*(o7)?\W*$
form.why: the shortest reply that commits a member to a call: the candidate for the cheapest act

form.name: one-line done report
form.text: ^\W*(done|placed|placed mine|placed some|did my part|did mine|done here|done and done)\W*(o7)?\W*$
form.why: the shortest report that a member's part is placed

form.name: salute
form.why: the salute, a token reply with no words

form.name: one-word assent or refusal
form.why: a vote cast in one word under a proposal

form.name: we did it
form.why: the shortest announcement of a finished work

form.name: where is it
form.why: the shortest question about place on the canvas

form.name: loss marked
form.why: the shortest turn marking a loss or the end

form.name: edited post
form.why: a post written over hours: the turn that changes after it is posted

form.name: sleep and hand-over
form.re: \b(going to (bed|sleep)|off to (bed|sleep)|goodnight|good night|wake up|woke up|while (we|you|i|they) (sleep|slept|were asleep)|night shift|time ?zones?|asleep)\b
form.why: turns that hand the work over across the day: timing as the members speak of it

form.name: the canvas clock
form.why: the cooldown, the clock the members did not set

form.name: the end in sight
form.re: \b(hours? left|minutes? left|until the end|before (it|place) ends|ends in|last (hour|few hours|minutes?)|final (hours?|minutes?))\b
form.why: turns timed against the end of the event
